summary: Jefferson Co., Montana site listed on Forest Lookouts as Private and Removed; little else found. Not the Chelan Co., WA site.

facts.status_note: The listing marks the lookout as removed.

access.note: The Forest Lookouts listing gives the site as Private; that label does not say whether it is open to visitors, so do not assume it is.

evidence.supports: grouped with Shingle Butte and Strawberry Butte in Jefferson County
evidence.quote: Shingle Butte Strawberry Butte Three Brothers Mountain

evidence.supports: Washington Three Brothers site is in Chelan County

evidence.quote: Constructed in 1934, this L-4 cab was removed in 1966.

notes_for_editor: One Montana source: a short Forest Lookouts entry that gives only 'Private' and 'Removed' under the name. No firelookout.com page was found (firelookout.com/mt/threebrothers.html returns 404), and the site is not on firelookout.org's Montana county list. The Mindat summit entry (a search snippet calls it 'A summit with 3 peaks') returned 403 and is not used. The record's agency 'Private' is an ownership label, not an agency; it is left as is for a human to decide. Build, design, staffing, fire and removal details were not found. Source 2 is the Washington site (US 1427, WA 327), a different place; it is cited only to tell readers apart. Checked 2026-10-21: the Forest Lookouts Montana index lists Three Brothers Mountain under JEFFERSON COUNTY, and the page entry reads Private and Removed; the Washington page gives Chelan County and the 1934 L-4 cab removed in 1966.
